centre.about_html:
Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres: Treating Addictions and Co-Occurring Disorders 

At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they take a comprehensive approach to treating substance and process addiction, mental health conditions, and co-occurring disorders. Their experienced masters-level therapists lead both group and individual therapy sessions, tailored to each client’s unique needs. Clients receive three individual therapy sessions per week, along with a variety of group therapy sessions and workshops. 

 

They offer residential treatment programs ranging from 30 to 90 days, along with an intensive outpatient program (IOP) and a virtual rehab program. Before beginning treatment, clients receive a psychiatric assessment to determine the best program for their specific needs. During treatment, they have access to addiction counsellors 24/7, along with a range of wellness options to support their recovery journey. 

Addiction Treatment Programs at Trafalgar: Hope and Healing 

At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they believe that hope and healing are possible for everyone struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their residential treatment programs provide a safe and supportive environment for clients to focus on their recovery, with 24/7 access to addiction counsellors and regular therapy sessions. 

 

Their unique virtual rehab program allows clients to receive treatment from anywhere, with ongoing support and therapy sessions delivered through an online platform. They also offer a complimentary 30-day residential treatment program for first responders and military personnel, through their Local Heroes Support program. 

Group and Family Programs: Supporting Addiction Recovery 

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understands that addiction recovery is not just an individual journey, but one that impacts loved ones as well. They offer specialized group and family programs to support clients and their families throughout the recovery process. 

 

Their weekly group therapy sessions include psychoeducational skill groups, skill-based workshops, gender-specific groups, and PTSD groups for first responders. They also provide individual therapy sessions with experienced therapists who use evidence-based practices such as EMDR, CBT, and DBT. A pain management group is available for clients dealing with chronic pain, while on-site support groups for friends and family meet regularly.

Trafalgar’s Approach to Addiction Treatment: A Holistic and Personalized Plan 

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understand that addiction recovery is not a one-size-fits-all approach and that each client has unique needs. They take a holistic and personalized approach to addiction treatment, utilizing evidence-based practices and experienced staff to create a plan tailored to each individual. 

 

Their comprehensive residential treatment program provides clients with access to addiction counsellors, individual therapy sessions, group therapy sessions, and wellness options. They also offer follow-up care after treatment through their alumni program and virtual aftercare program. With a focus on hope and healing, Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is committed to helping clients achieve long-term sobriety and improved mental health. 



Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres- Center Overview

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is a premier private rehab center that specializes in providing unparalleled care to individuals struggling with mental health, drug and alcohol abuse. Located in beautiful Erin, Ontario, the center offers a wide range of treatment programs and therapies that cater to the unique needs of each client.

The rehab center boasts of a fully equipped facility that offers 12-step programs, outpatient drug rehab, as well as individual, group, and family therapy and counseling. Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres also believes in treating the whole person, and therefore offers holistic therapies such as yoga and meditation, art and nature therapy, and nutritional counseling. All these services are aimed at promoting overall wellness and providing clients with the support they need to overcome addiction and achieve long-term recovery.

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres: Treating Addictions and Co-Occurring Disorders 

At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they take a comprehensive approach to treating substance and process addiction, mental health conditions, and co-occurring disorders. Their experienced masters-level therapists lead both group and individual therapy sessions, tailored to each client’s unique needs. Clients receive three individual therapy sessions per week, along with a variety of group therapy sessions and workshops. 

 

They offer residential treatment programs ranging from 30 to 90 days, along with an intensive outpatient program (IOP) and a virtual rehab program. Before beginning treatment, clients receive a psychiatric assessment to determine the best program for their specific needs. During treatment, they have access to addiction counsellors 24/7, along with a range of wellness options to support their recovery journey. 

Addiction Treatment Programs at Trafalgar: Hope and Healing 

At Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres, they believe that hope and healing are possible for everyone struggling with addiction and mental health issues. Their residential treatment programs provide a safe and supportive environment for clients to focus on their recovery, with 24/7 access to addiction counsellors and regular therapy sessions. 

 

Their unique virtual rehab program allows clients to receive treatment from anywhere, with ongoing support and therapy sessions delivered through an online platform. They also offer a complimentary 30-day residential treatment program for first responders and military personnel, through their Local Heroes Support program. 

Group and Family Programs: Supporting Addiction Recovery 

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understands that addiction recovery is not just an individual journey, but one that impacts loved ones as well. They offer specialized group and family programs to support clients and their families throughout the recovery process. 

 

Their weekly group therapy sessions include psychoeducational skill groups, skill-based workshops, gender-specific groups, and PTSD groups for first responders. They also provide individual therapy sessions with experienced therapists who use evidence-based practices such as EMDR, CBT, and DBT. A pain management group is available for clients dealing with chronic pain, while on-site support groups for friends and family meet regularly.

Trafalgar’s Approach to Addiction Treatment: A Holistic and Personalized Plan 

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres understand that addiction recovery is not a one-size-fits-all approach and that each client has unique needs. They take a holistic and personalized approach to addiction treatment, utilizing evidence-based practices and experienced staff to create a plan tailored to each individual. 

 

Their comprehensive residential treatment program provides clients with access to addiction counsellors, individual therapy sessions, group therapy sessions, and wellness options. They also offer follow-up care after treatment through their alumni program and virtual aftercare program. With a focus on hope and healing, Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is committed to helping clients achieve long-term sobriety and improved mental health. 



Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres- Center Overview

Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres is a premier private rehab center that specializes in providing unparalleled care to individuals struggling with mental health, drug and alcohol abuse. Located in beautiful Erin, Ontario, the center offers a wide range of treatment programs and therapies that cater to the unique needs of each client.

The rehab center boasts of a fully equipped facility that offers 12-step programs, outpatient drug rehab, as well as individual, group, and family therapy and counseling. Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres also believes in treating the whole person, and therefore offers holistic therapies such as yoga and meditation, art and nature therapy, and nutritional counseling. All these services are aimed at promoting overall wellness and providing clients with the support they need to overcome addiction and achieve long-term recovery.
